summoning_condition.en: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If you do, its original ATK becomes 1000.

requirement.en: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, if you have "Staaart Boasting About Your Health!" in your Graveyard, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK until the end of this turn.
